dogecoin.text: @CNBC Dogecoin's meteoric rise is due to tweets  by Musk/Cuban. Greater fool theory applies to cryptos. Investors can lose all. A bubble waiting to burst. Everytime, #bitcoin or any crypto goes north, I worry for gullible investors. #Bitcoin is just an inane mathematical abstraction.
@BTCTN Sorry Mr Musk, but I don't see the link between Dogecoin and the pandemic.
